newsitem.title: MOROCCO: World Bank plans to give Morocco $70 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: World Bank plans to give Morocco $70 mln credit.

text.p: The World Bank plans to grant Morocco a credit line of $70 million to help improve the country's rural infrastructure, a Moroccan official said on Tuesday.

A World Bank delegation led by Daniel Ritchie, director of North Africa and Iran department, announced during its current visit to Morocco the $70 million credit line "will be devoted to modernise basic infrastructure such as electricity and water resources in remote areas", the official said.
